notes: Vertical/narrow native NUI plus combat hotfix 0.7.10.3. In AUTO, up to three obvious weak enemies are handled with weapons instead of native offensive spells/rods; elemental ammo is penalized on trivial targets so mundane compatible ammo is conserved/used first when available. Creature skin/hide resistance also feeds real ammo scoring. Manual MELEE/BURST behavior remains unchanged. UI splits HP/mode/action into vertical lines and translates raw English action names.
